name: agentic-skill-router
description: Agentic Search-inspired non-vectorized routing and management for installed Agent Skills.

interface.shortDescription: Non-vectorized Agent Skills routing and management
interface.longDescription: Agentic Skill Router is an Agentic Search-inspired, non-vectorized routing and management layer for installed Agent Skills. It searches local skill metadata as an auditable corpus, routes long-tail requests back to disabled skills only when metadata supports the choice, audits installed skills, suggests unused or stale entries, and safely disables selected skills by renaming SKILL.md files so they can be restored later.
defaultPrompt: Route this request to a disabled skill
